searchIndex.title: Search index
searchIndex.description: The shop search reads from its own index, which updates a few seconds after a product changes.
searchIndex.howAuto: Adding, editing, hiding or deleting a product already updates the index by itself; there is nothing to do.
searchIndex.howManual: Sync again only for the first load, when the index is empty or has drifted from the catalog, or after the search system was rebuilt.
searchIndex.howCost: Every product is read again, so it can take tens of seconds. Customers keep searching meanwhile.
searchIndex.confirmDescription: Every product on sale is rebuilt in the index and hidden or deleted ones are dropped. It is safe and can be run again.

searchIndex.forbidden: Only an administrator can sync the search index.
searchIndex.dltTitle: Changes that did not reach the index
searchIndex.dltDescription: If the catalog or Elasticsearch stays down too long, a change is set aside instead of being lost. Once they are back, run them again here or sync everything again.
searchIndex.dltPending: {count} changes are waiting to be run again.
searchIndex.dltUnavailable: The number of waiting changes could not be read.
searchIndex.dltSkipped: {count} changes were unreadable and passed over; they stay in the failure queue until it expires.
searchIndex.dltBlocked: Stopped because a change failed again; {count} changes are still waiting. Check the catalog and Elasticsearch, then try again.
searchIndex.dltReplayFailed: Could not run them again. Try again later.
